title: Kestrel and the Ledger
author: Ulyana Voss
blurb: Lior Sandoval, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
